coastal.title: Several evacuation orders in Boston Bar area downgraded to alerts
coastal.description: The Brunswick Creek wildfire is still considered out of control; however, BC Wildfire advises the risk has sufficiently subsided and residents may return home if they choose to.

coastal.title: Metro Vancouver, Fraser Valley under air quality advisory due to wildfire smoke
coastal.description: Some parts of Metro Vancouver have air quality ranked at a Level Nine, with the Eastern Fraser Valley ranked at a Level 10 plus, which means very high risk.

kamloops.title: Dry lightning, hot weather expected to increase wildfire conditions in BC Interior
kamloops.description: As the damage from the devastating wildfire along Okanagan Lake in British Columbia is being assessed, officials are warning of the potential of more fires.

kamloops.title: Photos show Bradley Creek wildfire destruction as resident describes losing everything
kamloops.description: Amber Cardenas has lived on the Okanagan Indian Band reserve for about 12 years and she and her family were forced to flee the fast-moving Bradley Creek wildfire on Saturday.

cariboo.title: Massive Pear Lake wildfire devastates Clinton ranch as owner fights flames
cariboo.description: Barb Edmonson stayed behind to fight the fire when it threatened the Firefly Ranch in Clinton. She said the ranch is her life and she couldn't just leave.

all.title: Fire and Climate – a special and timely collection
all.description: The 2026 wildfire season shows us that with increased wildland fire risk, more intense fire behaviour, longer seasons, and fire evolving across many landscapes, a changing climate poses significant challenges to today’s fire regimes and management strategies. The International Journal of Wildland Fire has published a Special Collection to showcase papers from and inspired by […]

all.title: B.C. fire officials say conditions are ‘explosive’ with unprecedented fuel dryness
all.description: "Throughout British Columbia, we have over 1,000 personnel directly engaged in the fight in our wildfire response efforts," Minister of Forests Ravi Parmar said.
